title: progress on long forms
rule: On long forms, show a clear progress indicator of how much is done and how much remains.

citation.source: NN/g — 4 Principles to Reduce Cognitive Load in Forms

pass_when: Long form shows done vs remaining progress.
fail_when: Long form has no progress indication.
overview: On long forms, show clear progress for how much is done versus remaining.
apply_when: Long multi-section or multi-page forms users must finish.
not_when: Short single-screen forms with no meaningful remaining work.
agent_hint: Show done-versus-remaining progress on long forms.
description: On long forms, show a clear progress indicator of how much is done and how much remains. Pass when the long form shows done versus remaining progress; fail when a long form has no progress indication. Progress orientation reduces uncertainty about remaining effort without inventing a specific widget brand or forcing a progress UI on short forms.
